description:
## Origin

Arc 38 user-tier QA pass (PR #18 → main 0b5f7f3 / 54f8d46). After activating bj5 user-tier drift detection via `bash substrate/install.sh --target user`, check.sh reported 0 drifted / 0 missing / 16 obsolete. Inspection revealed 14/16 came from the agent-gauntlet substrate (mtime 2026-04-30 same install event; role taxonomy Colonel/Major Pliny/Captain Nestor; refs to `cu5.x` / `cu6.x` / `cu7.x` gauntlet ticket-ids). PRINCIPAL archived 7 gauntlet-orchestration skills (no the-stoa equivalent) to `~/.claude/skills-archive/`; the remaining 9 obsolete are cross-substrate utility skills that ARE useful in the-stoa workflow but are not lifecycle-tracked.

## The 7-8 port candidates

Each is genuinely useful and framework-agnostic (or near-agnostic), already references the-stoa-compatible role names in several cases, but ships with stale prose tied to the gauntlet origin substrate. Porting brings them into `substrate/skills/` for proper lifecycle-tracking via check-substrate-updates.

1. **runner** — tool-mediated probe execution. Refs DAEDALUS / ARGUS / ADA / VERA / CATO (already the-stoa-compatible names). Stale: `cu5.22 §6c invariant` references. Modernization: replace cu5.22 refs with op-disc §5 dispatch-discipline refs.

2. **format-validate** — schema-conformance validator (JSON / markdown frontmatter / YAML). Framework-agnostic. Stale: refs `LINT_YAML closed the YAML+schema gap` (gauntlet ancestor). Modernization: lead with the-stoa SKILL.md / design.md / team-spec validation use-cases.

3. **save-verdict** — canonical-path verdict saving. Refs ARGUS / VERA / CATO (already the-stoa-compatible). Stale: refs gauntlet `verification/<ticket>/` directory shape. Modernization: align with the-stoa's `agents/verdicts/<ticket>/` convention per op-disc §5.7.

4. **cite-check** — citation extractor + validator (md links + bare URLs + file:line cross-refs). Refs DAEDALUS / STRABO (the-stoa names). Stale: refs `cu6.3 cleanup`. Modernization: align with cite-comment discipline per Arc-38 A17 / op-disc §17 base-vs-custom.

5. **copy-artifact** — sha256-verified byte-faithful copy. Refs `Captain Nestor` + `cu7.2`. Modernization: refs to op-disc §5.11 paste-archival pattern (which uses git mv now); skill is the non-git-mv shape.

6. **edit-json** — RFC-6901 path-anchored JSON mutation. Refs `cu7.4 YAML→JSON migration`. Modernization: lead with substrate-tier use-cases (plugin manifests, schema files, .substrate-manifest if it ever goes JSON-native).

7. **transcribe-bw-to-disk** — bw bead content -> durable disk path with sha256 verify. Refs `Captain Nestor` + `cu7.2`. Modernization: align with paste-archival §5.11 + handoff-author indirection patterns; bw-bead-to-disk is a complement to the §5.11 paste pattern.

8. **1password-secrets** (optional 8th) — secrets-manager pattern reference. Mostly framework-agnostic stub. Cross-ref to existing `credential-discipline` skill in substrate already; could be either folded into credential-discipline OR kept as standalone for the 1Password-specific case. Decide at design time.

## Self-application (per Arc 38 A14 family)

Porting these skills changes the user-tier substrate surface. After install.sh re-deploys, check.sh `--workspace ~/.claude` should report **obsolete count drop from 9 -> 1** (only `youtube-transcript-extract` remains as cross-substrate PRINCIPAL-authored). This is a directly verifiable acceptance criterion at arc close.

## Bundling guidance

- **Single arc (7-candidate)**: all 7 utilities ported in one gauntlet. Heavy but coherent — shared modernization-prose discipline + shared install.sh wiring update + shared check.sh verification at close.
- **Two-arc split**: e.g., (runner / format-validate / save-verdict) — probe-and-verdict cluster, then (cite-check / copy-artifact / edit-json / transcribe-bw-to-disk) — file-manipulation cluster. Easier review per arc.
- **8th 1password-secrets**: decide at design time (fold-into-credential-discipline OR standalone).

DAEDALUS picks bundling at design time per dispatch.

## Acceptance criteria

1. All N selected skills live at `substrate/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with prose modernized: no `cu5.x` / `cu6.x` / `cu7.x` refs; no `Colonel` / `Major Pliny` / `Captain Nestor` / `Lieutenant` taxonomy; the-stoa role refs used where applicable.
2. install.sh deploys the new skills at all 3 tiers (user / project / subproject) via the standard skill-deploy loop.
3. consumer-workspaces.txt unchanged (skills are universal, no registry change needed).
4. Cross-refs: at least one substrate-canon doc (op-disc / SPECIFICATION / a MAJOR / a CAPTAIN) cites each ported skill at its read-site per A6 / A17 cite-comment discipline.
5. **Verification at arc close**: `bash substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/check.sh --workspace ~/.claude` reports `0 drifted / 0 missing / 1 obsolete` (youtube-transcript-extract only). Live-verified, not echoed.
6. Each ported skill author frontmatter `author: Denson Smith` per A18 IMMUTABLE / CLAUDE.md global rule.

## Out of scope (hard-locks)

- Porting the 7 archived gauntlet-orchestration skills (arc-management / dispatch-lieutenant / spawn-pair-programmer / team-status / tier2-project-onboarding / tier2-task-routing / pulse-review). These have no the-stoa equivalent and are correctly archived at `~/.claude/skills-archive/`.
- Touching `youtube-transcript-extract` (PRINCIPAL-authored, cross-substrate by design — stays loose at user-tier).
- Restructuring `check-substrate-updates` beyond what this port requires (per Arc 38 bj5 envelope already shipped).
- Per-substrate-origin marker scheme (separate ticket if filed; structural-fix candidate from Arc 38 stoa--bbi accretion).

## Cross-refs

- Arc 38 ship: PR #18 -> main 0b5f7f3 (Arc 38 substrate architecture bundle: TIRO + bj5 + gq1)
- stoa--bbi (P4 ACCRETION) — substrate-principle refinement N-evidence anchor; this arc adds one more confirming instance
- op-disc §17 + §23 — base-vs-custom convention (these utilities go in base, framework-agnostic)
- op-disc §29 — multi-team interop (cross-substrate provenance context)
- op-disc §28 — Co-Authored-By trailer (apply per arc-N/build worktree)
- SPECIFICATION.md §13 — workplan; this slots after Arc 41 (post-§13.10 known-residue closure) or earlier per PRINCIPAL pick
title: Port 7-8 cross-substrate utility skills into the-stoa substrate (modernize + integrate with check-substrate-updates lifecycle)
